title: Research Pi main chat TUI reuse
goal: Investigate whether /chat can reuse Pi's main chat/session TUI display layer while preserving subagent context isolation.
constraints: Do not block P2 MVP grouped list + bottom status line.
Do not let subagent chat messages enter the main agent conversation context.
Display-layer reuse is acceptable only if semantic/context isolation remains intact.
If no safe SDK entry exists, keep the current lightweight overlay and avoid expanding it.
researchQuestions: Does Pi SDK expose a reusable main chat transcript/session component?
Can it render an external message source without appending to main conversation history?
Can input be routed to subagent pool/hub without becoming main-agent user input?
Can lifecycle/focus coexist with the main TUI and existing overlay behavior?
notes: User noted this has been attempted several times; priority is low, but any solution must avoid main agent context pollution.
